blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Australia affirmed their commitment to further enhance cooperation in security and defense during the sidelines of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits on Monday. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. met with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese in a bilateral meeting where they had a ceremonial exchange of the Kasandigan Philippines-Australia Leader’s Statement on Expanding Security and Defense Cooperation.
